metric_label: Published claims supported by a formal randomized marker-by-treatment interaction
numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands with explicit valid interaction estimate/test
indeterminate_handling: Retain in denominator; not in numerator unless interaction status is YES
report_precedence: Preferred full report, with all version links retained
mandatory_companion_counts: unique reports; trials; biomarker definitions; dependency clusters
prespecified_sensitivities: peer-reviewed-only; one claim per report; one claim per trial cluster

numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands using differential-benefit or treatment-selection language without formal randomized interaction evidence
indeterminate_handling: Ambiguous claim language remains denominator and is not numerator until adjudicated; report separately
report_precedence: Earliest public wording determines claim language; best eligible report determines evidence class

metric_label: Relevant randomized or controlled evaluation opportunity
numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands with trial_opportunity in RELEVANT_RANDOMIZED_TRIAL_EXISTS or CONTROLLED_NONRANDOMIZED_EXISTS
indeterminate_handling: Indeterminate remains denominator and not numerator

numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands with randomized opportunity and estimand_compatibility in EXACT or EXPLICITLY_COMPATIBLE
indeterminate_handling: Indeterminate remains denominator and not numerator

numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands with executable exact/compatible formula, estimand-aligned randomized opportunity, and both clinical and expression data publicly and lawfully accessible
indeterminate_handling: Any indeterminate axis remains denominator and not numerator; axes also reported separately
report_precedence: Best verified formula, trial and repository evidence
prespecified_sensitivities: strict exact-only; include controlled-access as separate sensitivity

numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands evaluated in a nonoverlapping external study/trial with identity and estimand compatibility adjudicated
indeterminate_handling: Unclear overlap/identity remains denominator and not numerator
mandatory_companion_counts: unique external reports; trials; dependency clusters

metric_label: Formal interactions accompanied by interval estimates
numerator_rule: Eligible claim-estimands with a formal interaction and reported or recoverable 95% interval
denominator_rule: Eligible unique claim_estimand_id with formal interaction status=YES
indeterminate_handling: Indeterminate interval status remains conditional denominator and not numerator
prespecified_sensitivities: published-only versus recoverable from sufficient statistics

numerator_rule: Eligible outer claim-estimands mapped exactly or explicitly compatibly to a frozen R5A claim-estimand
indeterminate_handling: Unresolved bridge remains denominator and not numerator
report_precedence: Versioned bridge table; frozen R5A is immutable
